Visual: The Red Mech charges into a nearby skyscraper's foundation during its attack. The entire building begins to buckle—windows shatter, steel beams exposed. As they continue fighting mid-air near the structure, the tower starts toppling over. Debris rains down around both mechs. Final frame shows both combatants frozen silhouetted against the falling building and explosion behind them.
Camera Motion: Wide Pull Back + Rotate. Dramatic retreat from close combat shot to reveal full scale of building collapse, rotating slightly to capture both figures against the destruction backdrop. End on freeze-frame impact.
